educationalModelNote: All numerical models are simplified educational models, not specifications of a real robot.

missions.title: SENSE THE BODY
missions.concept: Proprioceptive sensors measure different physical effects; no single sensor directly provides complete body state.
missions.scenario: Compare an IMU-like orientation cue, joint encoder information and contact confidence while the robot leans.
missions.goalText: Create a usable body-state estimate by keeping sensor bias and contact uncertainty under control.
missions.transferText: Recover confidence without pretending the uncertain foot is a perfect reference.

missions.title: TIMING & CALIBRATION
missions.concept: A precise measurement can still be wrong for control if its frame, calibration or timestamp is wrong.
missions.scenario: Rotate the head while a delayed, mis-timestamped camera observation is fused with body state.
missions.goalText: Keep the observation temporally aligned enough for the moving head.
missions.transferText: Tighten timing when motion becomes faster.

missions.title: FUSE SENSORS
missions.concept: Sensor fusion should weight information by uncertainty and failure mode, not by whichever sensor has the largest nominal resolution.
missions.scenario: Blend inertial and vision cues while one source becomes noisier.
missions.goalText: Choose a fusion weight that reduces the combined estimate error.
missions.transferText: Shift trust after the visual cue becomes unreliable.

missions.title: STATE ESTIMATION
missions.concept: An estimator predicts state, compares measurements with predictions and carries uncertainty; wrong contact assumptions can create confident drift.
missions.scenario: Tune process trust and measurement trust while a stance foot begins to slip.
missions.goalText: Keep estimate bias and uncertainty bounded.
missions.transferText: Stop over-trusting the false stationary-contact assumption.

missions.title: PERCEPTION UNDER UNCERTAINTY
missions.concept: Planning should consume uncertainty, sensor age and confidence; when perception degrades, safe behavior often means slowing, increasing clearance or asking for help.
missions.scenario: Pass a person in a corridor using uncertain range data.
missions.goalText: Preserve clearance after accounting for speed and uncertainty.
missions.transferText: Adapt speed or clearance when uncertainty expands.

missions.title: PERCEPTION GATE
missions.concept: Integrate sensor quality, timing, fusion, state uncertainty and degraded perception into decisions that remain safe.
missions.scenario: Navigate a service bay with motion, glare and intermittent contact uncertainty.
missions.goalText: Complete the three perception gate cases.

gateCases.name: UNCERTAINTY
gateCases.text: Keep total perception buffer below 0.45 m without stopping completely.

gateCases.name: DEGRADED MODE
gateCases.text: Maintain confidence above 55% and motion error below 4 cm.
